source_status: project-authored implementation task group after read-only agent scan; no live/model/provider/reviewer/runtime/browser/target/CI/git/release/deploy/automation action was performed
goal: Add the only Batch 45 route that can honestly change advisory-only/no-go later: a promotion-grade eval with frozen held-out corpus, explicit comparability mode, strict structured output, reviewer gate, cost/timeout policy and raw-temp-only retention before any approved run.

basis.current_boundary: B45-POSTQ4-T15-A01 keeps advisory-only/no-go after T14 model-change interpretation.
basis.t14_signal: T14 is positive current-best-quality evidence only: gpt-5.5/high, 16/16 completed, valid_pair_count=8, average_score_delta_percent=3.27, reviewer_calls_started=0, promotion_threshold_met=false and same_model_comparability_with_m26_t05_t12=false.
basis.why_new_group: Previous post-Q4 routes improved strict output hygiene and current-model signal quality, but no route yet freezes a promotion-grade corpus and approval packet before a future run.

agents_used.scope: read-only Batch 45 tests and verification gate scan

task_group.claim_ceiling: This packet designs the implementation route only. It does not prove behavior improvement, reviewer approval, M26/M35 reversal, runtime/browser/target readiness, CI/blocker promotion, release readiness or production readiness.

comparability_policy.current_model_comparison_rule: Allowed only if the approval packet states that the result is current-model quality evidence and not strict historical same-model comparability.

promotion_gate.minimum_primary_improvement: >=20% average improvement over baseline on valid pairs unless a later owner-approved packet changes the threshold before any run
promotion_gate.valid_pair_requirement: all frozen corpus tasks must produce schema-valid baseline and treatment outputs, or invalid pairs are quarantined and cannot support promotion

task_rows.scope: Scan current Batch 45 implementation and add the S8 promotion-grade eval task group to source packets, Track 11, registry, compact control-plane and tests.
acceptance: New source-owned task-group packet exists.
Track 11 names T16-T22 and the no-run approval boundary.
Registry, current-state docs and compact root files point to the new packet.
Regression tests assert no promotion and no unapproved actions.

task_rows.scope: Create a frozen held-out corpus manifest for the promotion-grade eval before any run.
acceptance: Corpus task IDs, source class, privacy class, difficulty, expected evidence and hashes are frozen before baseline/treatment execution.
Corpus is not edited after baseline starts; any change creates a new corpus version.
No raw private source bodies, secrets, raw private chat logs or unredacted PII are retained in repo.
stop_conditions: Stop if corpus data cannot be sanitized.
Stop if the corpus is tuned after result inspection.

task_rows.scope: Define the promotion-grade eval design packet: comparison mode, model policy, strict structured output schema, scoring rubric, invalid-output handling, thresholds, reviewer rubric and result contract.
acceptance: Design chooses either same-model baseline/treatment or explicit current-model comparison.
Strict structured output schema is named and failure handling is deterministic.
Reviewer gate, promotion threshold and unsupported-claim ceiling are explicit.
stop_conditions: Stop if comparability mode is ambiguous.
Stop if reviewer gate is optional for promotion.

task_rows.scope: Define run caps, timeout policy, retry policy, abort policy, raw-temp-only retention and sanitized rollup rules before any approval packet is executable.
acceptance: Max calls, max retries, timeout per call, total budget and stop-on-timeout behavior are explicit.
Raw outputs remain temp-only and are not retained in repo.
Sanitized rollup fields are enough for reviewer and decision gates without raw trace storage.
stop_conditions: Stop if raw output retention would enter repo.

task_rows.scope: Prepare exact owner approval text for the future promotion-grade eval run after T17-T19 are source-ready.
acceptance: Approval text names model, reasoning effort, comparison mode, corpus version, max calls, timeout, cost cap, reviewer policy, retention policy and stop conditions.
Packet states that it does not run anything by itself.
Approval cannot be reused after a consumed or aborted run.
stop_conditions: Stop if owner approval text is incomplete.
Stop if current pricing source or concrete USD cap is missing.

task_rows.scope: Attempt the approval preflight for the promotion-grade eval and stop before execution when exact owner approval is absent.
acceptance: Preflight verifies that the owner restated the exact T20 approval text before any model/provider/reviewer call.
When the exact T20 approval text is missing, no baseline, treatment, reviewer, setup or smoke call starts.
Blocked preflight packet records zero calls, zero cost, no temp root, no raw repo retention and no-unapproved-actions evidence.

task_rows.scope: Run or record the reviewer gate and produce the final promotion/no-go decision after T21 evidence exists.
acceptance: Reviewer verdict is not no_go before any promotion claim.
Decision separates behavior quality, static warning deltas, runtime/browser/target readiness and CI/blocker/governance readiness.
Control-plane and registry sync preserve unsupported claims and exact approval boundaries.
stop_conditions: Stop if reviewer is not run or returns no_go.
Stop if the result is below threshold.
Stop if promotion wording implies runtime/browser/target/CI/release readiness without separate proof.

approval_required_before_future_actions: Any live/model/provider rerun for same-model or current-model comparability.
Any runtime/live server or browser automation proof.
Any target workspace command or mutation.
Any database or production data access.
Any CI workflow, blocker enforcement or active automation creation.
Any git branch/stage/commit/push/PR, release, deploy, publish or external write.

results.evidence: JSON parsed successfully after verification-block sync.
No whitespace errors. Git reported CRLF/LF normalization warnings for edited files.
